rows.text: There was a row of odd things on the shelf.
A wooden wedge held up a marble.
A ruler stood on its edge.
A playing card stood on its edge.
A glass bead stood on its edge.
A paper flag stood on its edge.
Mara wanted to knock the bead off the shelf.
She gave the flag a hard push, and it slid.
